title: AQR: decomposing Buffett performance
operator: Andrea Frazzini, David Kabiller, Lasse Pedersen / AQR
historicalSetting: Published analysis of historical Berkshire performance

sources.sourceRole: Primary publication; account may be retrospective or interested-party

documentedClaim: The authors attribute performance to cheap, safe, high-quality stocks with leverage and favorable financing.
inferredMechanism: Quality/value and financing are competing explanations and useful controls for a claimed selection edge.
counterevidence: This published analysis was not replicated here and does not make insurance float available to the lab.
transferRequirements: Use realistic financing and relevant factor controls; do not equate gross historical performance with transferable net alpha.
outcomeBoundary: Public narrative already inspected; described cases are discovery examples, never untouched confirmation. No experimental market outcome dataset opened.
